description: Save answers application forms ask that a résumé does not state, so the candidate is asked once: their postal address (county included), the phone number forms get, citizenships, where they may work (per country: legally authorized, sponsorship needed now or later, and optionally the basis, visa type and status), relocation, office work, start date, notice period, accommodations, clearance, a salary range and history, date of birth and profile links, and how they want their agent to apply (résumé tailoring, cover letters, reviewing the first tailored résumé, and answer_mode: full_auto has their agent answer everything it can work out; save it only once they agreed to the full-automation sentence prepare_application gives you, which this server cannot check). get_application_checklist's setup lists what is still missing, with the questions to ask word for word and what the résumé already says (setup.prefill): a yes to a pre-filled value is their answer. Save what the candidate tells you in this conversation, in their words, as they say it (during an application too), and say in one line what you saved: no need to ask first. The answer carries setup as it now stands; setup.complete true means the setup is done. With no profile yet, this starts one. Never guess an answer. Self-identification questions (gender, ethnicity, veteran status, disability) are never saved: only whether to ask each time or always decline. A bank card or government ID number, a password or a token is refused and nothing is saved. A field you leave out is untouched, null removes an optional one, and a list you send replaces the saved list. get_application_checklist and prepare_application read what is saved.

accommodations.description: Need workplace accommodations (disability, religious or other)? prefer_not is kept as its own answer.

active_clearance.description: Holds an active government security clearance.

address_line2.description: Apartment or suite. null removes it.

answer_mode.description: How far their agent answers forms without them: ask_when_unsure (default) asks once about what only they know; full_auto answers everything that can honestly be worked out. Save full_auto only after the candidate agreed to the setup's FULL_AUTO_ATTESTATION, read to them word for word (prepare_application's steps carry it). A right to work, a citizenship, a self-identification answer, a criminal record and a legal waiver are never inferred either way.

citizenships.description: Countries of citizenship. Replaces the saved list; [] clears it.

county.description: County or district, when forms ask for it. null removes it.

cover_letter.description: When to write a cover letter: when_asked (default, when the form asks for one), always or never.

earliest_start_date.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) or words, e.g. "2 weeks after an offer".

foreign_government_ties.description: Family or other ties to a foreign government that employers must ask about.

phone.description: The number forms get, with its country code. Without one, forms use the résumé's. null removes it.

portfolio_url.description: A personal website or portfolio. null removes it.

postal_code.description: null removes it, for a country that has none.

requires_sponsorship.description: Now or in the future, for an employment visa.

resume_tailoring.description: How far tailor_resume may change the résumé for each job: off (send it as saved), keywords (default) or rewrite. Pass it as tailor_resume's intensity.

review_first_resume.description: Show the candidate the tailored résumé of their first application before it is used.

salary_history.description: Past base salaries, most recent first. Replaces the saved list.

state.description: State, province or region. null removes it, for a country that has none.

submit_mode.description: Kept from an earlier setup and changes nothing: the candidate fills in and submits every form themselves (2026-11-19).

us_person.description: A "U.S. person" under export-control rules (ITAR/EAR): a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, refugee or asylee. Only their own answer.

voluntary_disclosures.description: How voluntary self-identification questions are handled: ask_each_time (default) or always_decline ("Decline to self-identify"). No answer to one is ever saved.

willing_to_relocate.description: Willing to relocate for a role.

work_authorized_us.description: Legally authorized to work in the United States.

work_eligibility.description: Every country they would take a job in, each with both answers. Replaces the saved list; the United States entry also sets work_authorized_us and requires_sponsorship.

authorized.description: Are they legally authorized to work in this country?

basis.description: What the right to work rests on.

opt_status.description: For OPT: its status or end date, e.g. "STEM OPT until 2027-06".

requires_sponsorship.description: Will they now or in the future require employer sponsorship in this country?

visa_type.description: e.g. "F-1 OPT", "H-1B"; only with basis temporary or other.

name: update_application_answers
title: Save my application answers
